sample_unit: frequently asked cleft lip and palate surgery questions (responses compared by 11 surgeons and 29 non-medical individuals)

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT and academic/professional CL/P surgical information versus recommended patient reading level
links.effect: Readability scores for both ChatGPT and A/P sources surpassed advised levels for patient proficiency across seven readability formulas.
links.quote: For materials from both ChatGPT and A/P sources, readability scores surpassed advised levels for patient proficiency across seven readability formulas.

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing ChatGPT-generated patient education materials to academic/professional sources using blind evaluation by surgeons and non-medical individuals; does not evaluate a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
